title.en: Interest Rate on Money Lodged in Court

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
Supreme Court of Judicature Act
(Chapter 322 and Rules of Court)
Interest Rate on Money Lodged in Court
It is hereby notified for general information that, in exercise of the powers conferred by Order 90, Rule 6(1) of the Rules of Court (R 5), the Minister for Finance has fixed the rate of interest to be paid on money lodged in Court at 0.1% per annum, with effect from 1st April 2010.
